test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a linear race of 1000 m, A beats B by 50 m or 5 seconds. Determine how much time A takes to complete the race.
solution:
Given:

Track length = 1000 m

Formula used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

"A" beats "B" by 50 m or 5 sec, which means "B" covers 50 m in 5 sec

Speed of "B" = 50/5 = 10 m/s

Time to cover 1000 m = 1000/10 = 100 sec

"A" beats "B" by 5 sec means "A" reach 5 sec early

Time taken by "A" to complete the race = 100 – 5 = 95 sec

∴ The time taken by "A" to complete the race is 95 sec
